StartupTimingDefinitions.ProcessStartupMs: External Popen invocation to ready-file observation, including runtime startup, setup, imports, first inference and all warmup; target readiness poll interval is 50 ms. Not time to first output.
StartupTimingDefinitions.ImportMs: Python framework/package selection and import. numpy/psutil were imported before worker entry; their cost is captured by ProcessStartupMs.
StartupTimingDefinitions.ModelLoadMs: Model construction/loading/fusion and device placement; ORT includes provider/DLL preparation and session creation. Excludes input-file read and inference.
StartupTimingDefinitions.FirstInferenceMs: First host-visible warmup forward only, including input transfer and all output synchronization when using GPU.
StartupTimingDefinitions.ReadyToFirstOutputMs: Worker benchmark-setup entry through the first host-visible output; excludes interpreter/dotnet host startup.
StartupTimingDefinitions.WarmupMs: All warmup forwards, including the first one.
StartupTimingDefinitions.StartupMs: Original definition retained: worker benchmark-setup entry through completion of all warmup; excludes host startup.
